# QR Encoder

`qrcode-generator.js` is the unmodified CommonJS distribution of
qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator).
The accompanying MIT license is in `qrcode-generator.LICENSE`.

It is vendored so the mini program can generate scannable check-in codes
without requiring an npm build in WeChat Developer Tools.
